In-transit source-routed packets (Routing header with segments_left != 0, outer dst = this node, UDP checksum validly over the RFC 2460 s8.1 final destination) are LOCALLY DELIVERED by Rust (lichen-node/src/stack.rs:562-566 delivers when ipv6_destination_is_local_or_multicast, which reads only bytes 24..40 with no segments-left check; lichen-schc/src/link.rs:184-193 admits on L2 destination alone) and Python (lichen/routing/router.py:474-476 returns DELIVER_LOCAL on outer-dst match; node.py:978-982 hands it to the app). C honors forwarding precedence: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c:504-522 forwards and never delivers while segments_left != 0, and additionally rejects at router level what the P/R gates admit: RH3 final address equal to outer dst (router.c:400-402), misaligned address grids, and multiple Routing headers (saw_routing) — Rust/Python have no router-level SRH validation at all (RFC 8200 s4.4 processes only the first Routing header; P/R gates accept a second one and derive checksum scope last-wins). Attack: an authenticated neighbor unicasts outer-dst=victim + RH3 SL=1 to any final -\u003e the victim Rust/Python node consumes the datagram C would only relay; same wire bytes, opposite fate; downward RPL source-routed traffic silently terminates at the first Rust/Python relay. Fix direction: before local delivery, reject/deliver-local only when no Routing header has segments_left != 0 (mirror router.c), add router-level SRH validation (final != outer dst when SL!=0, single RH3, aligned address grid) to Rust and Python, and pin with cross-impl admission vectors. new_value: Fixed and pinned. (1) Rust survey_routing_headers and Python survey_source_route now mirror C parse_ipv6_dispatch: in-transit RH3 (SL!=0) has forwarding precedence and is never delivered locally; envelope checks (hop_limit==0, unspecified/multicast source), HBH first+unique, terminal UDP>=8/ICMPv6>=4 min lengths, bounded extension chain (max 3 exts, C -E2BIG parity incl. the smuggled-5th-header hole), RH3 type-3-only, aligned grid, RFC 6554 4.2 reserved policy (Cmpr/Pad zero, rest ignored), MAX_ROUTE_HOPS=8, grid content checks (unspecified/multicast/dup/src/dst), SL<hop_limit. (2) Python node.py: RPL-DIO classification requires ICMPv6 immediately after IPv6 header (no ext headers) so RH3-bearing datagrams fall through to survey; _relay_source_routed gated on outer-dst-is-self; PacketError caught. (3) Cross-impl admission corpus test/vectors/srh_admission.json (34 cases, fixed verdict literals, stdlib-only generator generate_srh_admission.py with --check, JSON schema) consumed by Rust unit test srh_admission_vectors_match_c_router_policy and python tests/rpl/test_srh_admission_vectors.py. (4) Fixed malformed test packets that the aligned policy correctly rejects: rust rfc6554_route_crosses test (NH59+payload -> real UDP header) and three python test_node.py packets. Validation: cargo test -p lichen-node all green (341 incl. vectors); python pytest full suite green except pre-existing unrelated vector-generator drift (filed project-LICHEN-worker6-wtxl); ruff/rustfmt clean on touched files; delta re-review clean. Review follow-ups filed: nuz5 (gateway ingress bypass), nd1h (secure_transport divergence), j2st (own-source forward check).
